Diljit Dosanjh asks fan not to place his name with Sikh symbol

Singer Diljit Dosanjh requested a foreign fan at a concert in Italy not to place his name alongside the sacred Sikh symbol, 'Ik Onkar'. The incident occurred during a concert where the fan was wearing a t-shirt with both Diljit Dosanjh's name and 'Ik Onkar'. Dosanjh addressed the fan, stating, "This is very precious," and asked him to remove his name from beside the symbol.
